review.reason: The course layout, mapped hazards, walking connectors, and single-surface greens read clearly. The hole 1 fairway is missing the clearly visible alternating mowing stripes required across every fairway section.

issues.detail: The oval hole 1 fairway between T1 and G1 has no distinct alternating lighter and darker bands crossing it edge to edge at thumbnail scale.
issues.consequence: It reads more like unstriped common turf than a clearly identifiable fairway, weakening the visual distinction between the playing surface and surrounding rough. This is an overview appearance issue, not a change to gameplay.
